01_MAP.md: Record the inspected unit title, exact source locator, boundaries, prerequisites, dependency role, depth class and reason for selection. Never infer source structure from an online summary.
02_DEEP_RECONSTRUCTION.md: For each important concept: what it is, why it exists, the problem solved, prerequisites, causal mechanism, state, inputs, outputs, assumptions, constraints, edge cases, failure modes, interactions and implementation consequences. Explain observability, a minimal implementation, real-system differences, evidence and uncertainty. Use original prose and claim-level epistemic labels.
03_CONCEPT_GRAPH.md: Show labeled relationships established by this unit. Link claims and source locators; mark prerequisite concepts not yet established. Promote to the global knowledge graph only after review.
04_MECHANISMS.md: Trace causal steps and state transitions. Define boundaries and interfaces, then change an assumption and predict the consequences. Separate abstract model from physical or software implementation.
05_EXAMPLES.md: Create original worked examples with explicit inputs, intermediate steps and outputs. Include a boundary case and a counterexample. Label computed examples separately from observed measurements.
06_FORMALISMS.md: Define symbols, domains, units, premises and assumptions. Derive each equation or cite its exact source; verify algebra and show where the model ceases to apply.
07_CONNECTIONS.md: Connect the mechanism to established prior artifacts and future dependency targets. Keep forward connections provisional; an analogy cannot replace a mechanism.
08_QUESTIONS.md: Write recall, why/how, state-tracing, counterfactual, failure and transfer questions. Keep answers separate from the first learner attempt and record the source needed to assess them.
09_EXPERIMENTS.md: Link a bounded protocol with hypothesis, variables, controls, setup, procedure, measurements and alternatives. Observed result remains NOT YET OBSERVED until actual execution and raw evidence.
10_PROJECT_LINKS.md: Identify the specific project component this concept enables, its prerequisites, design consequence and acceptance check. Do not claim an implementation exists unless inspected.
11_SOURCE_REFERENCES.md: List resource IDs, actual edition/revision, exact inspected locators, claim coverage and short attributed quotations only when necessary. Distinguish supplied source from external support.
12_MASTERY_TEST.md: Specify unaided explanation, a new application, implementation or formal construction, failure diagnosis and prediction/observation tasks. Link the later learner attempt; generated answers are not mastery.
13_GAPS.md: Record unreadable/missing source portions, uncertain statements, prerequisite gaps, unresolved contradictions and omitted sections with reasons. Give a small next verification action for each blocking gap.
